critical_discrepancies.claim: Documentation and docstrings claim '300+ compounds with spectral data'.
critical_discrepancies.reality: backend/compounds/database.py contains exactly 21 compounds. Frontend scripts contain 10 compounds.
critical_discrepancies.severity: CRITICAL. Must be accurately reported as 21 curated model compounds in any manuscript.

critical_discrepancies.claim: Claims interferogram generation with Fourier transformation to spectrum.
critical_discrepancies.reality: backend/science/ftir.py bypasses FFT and directly computes Gaussian absorption bands in the frequency domain.
critical_discrepancies.severity: HIGH. Manuscript must describe the actual Gaussian summation mechanism rather than claiming optical FFT simulation.

critical_discrepancies.claim: Claims 'Bayesian Knowledge Tracing' and 'Machine Learning Analyzer'.
critical_discrepancies.reality: Implements basic exponential moving average and rule-based peak-count tolerance matching.
critical_discrepancies.severity: HIGH. Reframe as rule-based heuristics to prevent integrity challenges during review.
